modules_reviewed.finding: Reads Hotspawn scheduled CS2 API for fixture inventory only; crowd pick percentages are ignored; exact-name Polymarket CLOB order books enforce MAX_SPREAD = 0.12 and <= 8h freshness; unverified cells remain null.

Executes fallback ladder only when featured exact-name resolution leaves no money line: scoped aliases + Polymarket/Kalshi/Smarkets exchanges (spread <= 0.15, 60s start-time gate) -> Thunderpick/Bovada/Pinnacle bookmakers (sum implied 0.85..1.35, median consensus across independent families) -> official Valve VRS (<= 35d, 5-player roster check) -> bo3.gg MAP series-form model.

Fits MAP rating on 5-point grid [300..2600] with Gaussian prior SD 250 around median rated-opponent points; requires >= 8 finished BO series against >= 3 Valve-rated opponents inside 120 days; flags low_confidence when posterior SD > 100 or n < 12.

Renders mobile-first Executive Summary (/), All Researched Picks (/origination/), Featured Market Picks (/picks/), Unresolved & Limitations (/unresolved/), and Flagged for Review (/review/); auto-discovers newest live-coverage.json and all research/*/flags.json without mutating canonical data/latest.json.

Runs every 4 hours (`23 */4 * * *`, well inside the 4–8h SLA), executes collect -> originate -> build -> audit_rows --strict -> acceptance_audit --strict -> Playwright mobile checks -> root_publish + deploy-pages.
